product-scope.value: Supplier pages describe an app for iOS and Android alongside website, daily-email and audio access, with reading history and progress tracking in the app.

product-history.value: The service identifies itself as The Bible with Nicky and Pippa Gumbel, commentary formerly known as Bible in One Year, and attributes it to Alpha International.

pricing.value: No paid plan or purchase requirement was published in the reviewed website and app-promotion material.

editorial.assessment: The Bible with Nicky and Pippa Gumbel is a structured devotional Bible-reading product, not a research library, church database or group-management platform. Its British operator and familiar Alpha context make it a relevant UK option for churches that want a simple shared reading rhythm, but leaders should assess the commentary’s theological and pastoral fit before using it as formal teaching material.
